title: Legal Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – LEGAL EXECUTIVE

**Department:** Legal  
**Designation:** Legal Executive  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Construction  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Legal Head / Management

1. Job Purpose

The Legal Executive will be responsible for handling day-to-day legal activities of the company, with a primary focus on **real estate and construction-related legal matters, property documentation, agreements, legal compliance, due diligence, and coordination with external advocates and government authorities**.

The role requires strong attention to detail, good drafting skills, timely follow-up, and the ability to identify and escalate potential legal risks to management.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Property & Real Estate Legal Work

* Conduct preliminary legal verification and documentation review for properties.
* Assist in property title verification and due diligence.
* Review and maintain property-related documents, including title deeds, sale deeds, agreements, approvals and supporting records.
* Coordinate with advocates for title search, legal opinions and property-related legal matters.
* Identify potential legal issues or risks relating to properties and escalate them to management.
* Assist in documentation related to land acquisition, development and sale transactions.

B. Agreement & Document Drafting

* Draft, review and coordinate various legal documents and agreements.
* Handle agreements such as:
* Sale Agreements
* Sale Deeds
* Joint Development Agreements
* Construction Agreements
* Vendor Agreements
* Contractor Agreements
* Lease / Rental Agreements
* MoUs
* Notices and legal correspondence
* Ensure agreements are properly executed, stamped and registered wherever applicable.
* Maintain proper records of original and executed legal documents.

C. Legal Compliance

* Monitor legal and statutory requirements applicable to the company's real estate and construction activities.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely compliance.
* Maintain a legal compliance tracker and follow up on pending matters.
* Support the company in matters relating to RERA, registration, property documentation and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Keep track of important renewal dates, registrations, licences and approvals.

D. Litigation & Legal Matters

* Maintain a record of ongoing and potential legal cases.
* Coordinate with external advocates and legal consultants.
* Collect required documents and information from internal departments for legal cases.
* Track court dates, hearings, notices and case developments.
* Prepare case status reports for management.
* Ensure timely response to legal notices and correspondence.
* Escalate critical legal matters to the Legal Head / Management immediately.

E. Government & Authority Coordination

* Coordinate with government departments and statutory authorities wherever required.
* Assist in matters involving registration offices, local authorities, revenue departments and other relevant authorities.
* Follow up on property-related applications, approvals and documentation.
* Maintain records of submissions, acknowledgements and communications.

F. Contract & Vendor Legal Support

* Review contracts and agreements received from vendors, contractors and service providers.
* Highlight legal risks, unfavourable clauses and contractual obligations.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Projects, Finance and other departments for contract-related matters.
* Track contractual obligations, expiry dates and renewal requirements.

G. Internal Legal Support

* Provide legal support to HR, Finance, Procurement, Projects, Marketing and Management.
* Review official letters, notices and legal communications before issue wherever required.
* Provide preliminary legal observations on business-related documents.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and client legal information.
* Assist management in reducing legal and contractual risks.

3. Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of **property and real estate laws**
* Good understanding of **RERA and construction-related legal matters**
* Strong legal drafting and documentation skills
* Contract review and negotiation skills
* Knowledge of litigation procedures and legal notices
* Good research and analytical skills
* Strong follow-up and coordination ability
* Attention to detail
* Good written and verbal communication
* Ability to identify legal risks
* Good knowledge of MS Office / Excel / Word
* Ability to maintain legal records and trackers
* High level of confidentiality and professional integrity

4. Qualification

**Essential:**

* LL.B / B.L. from a recognized institution.

**Preferred:**

* LL.M. or additional certification in Corporate / Real Estate Law.
* Experience in a real estate, construction, property development or corporate legal environment.

5. Experience

**2–5 years of relevant experience**, preferably in:

* Real Estate Companies
* Construction Companies
* Property Development Companies
* Corporate Legal Departments
* Law Firms handling property / real estate matters

Candidates with practical experience in **property documentation, agreement drafting, title verification, RERA-related matters and legal coordination** will be preferred.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of legal documentation
* Accuracy of agreements and legal documents
* Timely closure of legal queries
* Legal compliance status
* Timely follow-up of litigation and legal notices
* Property due diligence completion
* Contract review turnaround time
* Reduction of legal/documentation risks
* Proper maintenance of legal records
* Timely reporting of critical legal issues to management

7. Personal Attributes

* Professional and ethical approach
* Strong ownership and accountability
* Good judgement and decision-making ability
* Proactive follow-up
* Ability to work under deadlines
* Confidentiality and discretion
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments
* Willingness to travel to sites / registration offices / government offices when required

To Apply: WhatsApp - 7397002111 or Mail to hr@gfhil.com

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Legal Executive
description:
We are looking to recruit Legal Executive for the Legal & Compliance Department at Coimbatore. The selected candidate will be responsible for handling compliance-related activities and legal coordination for operations across India and GCC. The role involves regulatory compliance tracking, legal documentation, coordination with internal departments and external legal counsels, maintenance of records, and monitoring statutory requirements across the respective jurisdictions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 Monitor and ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies for assigned regions.

 Maintain and update compliance trackers, legal records, licenses, agreements, and statutory documents.

 Coordinate with business teams, HR, finance, operations, and external legal consultants for compliance-related matters.

 Assist in drafting, reviewing, and maintaining legal notices, agreements, declarations, undertakings, and compliance documents.

 Track renewal timelines for licenses, registrations, agreements, visas, CRs, and other statutory compliances.

 Support in handling cheque bounce matters, legal notices, litigation coordination, and recovery follow-ups.

 Prepare MOMs, compliance reports, summaries, and management updates.

 Conduct legal and regulatory research related to labour laws, commercial laws, and corporate compliances.

 Maintain confidentiality of legal and business information.

 Assist seniors in audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions.

**Eligibility Criteria:**

 Strong communication and drafting skills.

 Proficiency in MS Office and documentation management.

 LL.B. graduate with relevant experience in legal/compliance functions.

 Experience in corporate compliance, legal documentation, or litigation coordination preferred.

 Good drafting, coordination, and follow-up skills.

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines efficiently.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹23,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
